scripts.export:all: npm run export:json && npm run export:csv
scripts.view:stats: node scripts/exportData.js --format json --limit 100 --pretty | node -e "const data=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')); console.log('\n=== Stats Summary ==='); console.log('Total Records:', data.recordCount); console.log('Date Range:', data.data[0]?.timestamp, 'to', data.data[data.data.length-1]?.timestamp); console.log('Avg Multiplier:', (data.data.reduce((sum,r)=>sum+(r.multiplier||r.crashMultiplier||0),0)/data.data.length).toFixed(2));"
